title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：resolution　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 resolution 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the elder ① made the resolution that no youth in the village would have counted, and he said the making was the whole of the year. The ② resolution, meaning the decision itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a resolution, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ resolution in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ resolution at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A resolution, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the elder said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the resolution was the whole of the matter, meaning the will and not the decision. The ⑥ resolution, meaning the will and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; resolution, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a decision and a will. He said the will is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ resolution had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ resolution of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of counting; resolution, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ resolution I remember is the decision counted in the memoir, which closed in 1979 and is still counted as the quietest in the village. A ⑩ resolution, my mother said in 1981, is the only decision that improves by being counted; every resolution, she said, is a will that has agreed to look like a decision. She said the will was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 决心；决议（指村子里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 决心；决议（指那项决心本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the resolution 下这一项决心
D. n. 决心；决议（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 决心之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的决心之事）
F. n. 决心；决议（指回忆录里写到、被清点的那一项）
G. n. 决心、决心（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 决心（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the resolution that no youth in the village would have counted
The resolution, meaning the decision itself and not the staff
the resolution at the far gate
the resolution was the whole of the matter
the resolution had become a line in a memoir
The resolution of the whole thing
A resolution, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: make the resolution 意为“下这一项决心”，1972 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯清点的一项决心做了一遍。
resolution 意为“决心；决议”，指那项决心本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
resolution 意为“决心；决议”，指村子里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
resolution 意为“决心；决议”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
resolution 意为“决心、决心”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这项决心就是那件事的全部。
resolution 意为“决心”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那项决心，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
resolution 意为“决心；决议”，指回忆录里写到、被清点的那一项，到 1977 年这一项成了回忆录里的一行。
resolution 意为“决心之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的决心之事是一处村子和三个年头的清点。
resolution 意为“决心；决议”，我记得的是回忆录里清点过的那一项，1979 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一项。
resolution 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，决心是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的决心。
